# Third-Party Assets

These files are served locally; the browser makes no font, icon or image CDN requests.

- Lucide static icons: version 0.468.0, https://lucide.dev, ISC licence.
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lucide-static@0.468.0/
- DM Sans Latin regular and bold: Fontsource package version 5.2.5, SIL Open Font Licence.
  Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/dm-sans@5.2.5/

Upstream licence files are included alongside the assets.

## Sign-In Photography

Decorative photographs are used only on the signed-out screen, not as customer
